items.title: Define execution mode contract and story scope
items.context: Docs define conservative, authority-verified, and full-autopilot modes as completion policies, including what each mode may automate, what each mode must leave manual, and which authority claims remain forbidden.

happy.desc: README and host-overflow docs include a three-mode matrix with Conservative as default/manual-merge.

edge.desc: Docs explicitly distinguish unattended development from unattended production authority and main merge authority.

adversarial.desc: Docs do not claim receiptVerified=true or productionDone=true for local diagnostic receipts or conservative runs.

items.title: Add autopilot policy schema and mode permission matrix
items.context: Add normalized autopilot mode policy fields for auto dispatch, validate, fix, story integration, DONE advance, main merge, server receipt, iteration/runtime/budget limits, and stop conditions.
items.userSees: CLI shows: "Autopilot policy: conservative authorized; storyIntegration=false; mainMerge=false".

happy.desc: Conservative mode normalizes with allowAutoDispatch/allowAutoValidate true and auto integration/main merge false.

edge.desc: Authority-verified mode requires server authority receipt before auto DONE/main merge privileges are considered allowed.

adversarial.desc: Full-autopilot policy refuses missing maxIterations, unbounded runtime/budget, or missing stopOnConflict/stopOnScopeViolation.

items.title: Implement conservative autopilot_run
items.context: Create lattice autopilot_run --mode=conservative to dispatch, watch/review, validate, and generate merge plans without auto-integrating or marking production authority.
items.userSees: A conservative run returns evidence and a manual merge plan while saying no automatic merge was performed.

happy.desc: Conservative autopilot_run creates/uses a dispatch, reviews it, runs validation, and records a manual merge plan.

edge.desc: Conservative mode classifies dispatch failure or validation failure as blocked/diagnostic without claiming accepted completion.

adversarial.desc: Conservative mode never auto-merges and always keeps authorityChanged=false, receiptVerified=false, productionDone=false.

items.title: Define host-native delegation evidence contract
items.context: Add a host-native delegation contract for Codex calling Claude or Claude calling Codex externally while Lattice supplies handoff pack, receipt schema, transcript path, and review commands.
items.userSees: Users can choose host-native delegation and receive exact handoff/receipt/transcript instructions instead of an opaque runner.

happy.desc: Host-native plan output includes handoff pack path, prompt path, receipt path, transcript expectation, and review command.

edge.desc: A host-native delegation with missing receipt remains needs_receipt and produces nextAction instructions.

adversarial.desc: A natural-language host claim without receipt/transcript is not accepted as completed evidence.

items.title: Integrate Lattice-controlled dispatch path
items.context: Wire autopilot into existing dispatch_auto and Claude Code real runner while preserving policy opt-in, allowed paths, command allowlist, transcript, and runner metadata.
items.userSees: Autopilot can use the existing policy-bound dispatch_auto path for controlled Claude or fake-host execution.

happy.desc: Autopilot invokes dispatch_auto under an authorized fake policy and exposes dispatchId/status/review evidence.

edge.desc: Autopilot refuses Claude real subprocess when policy lacks allowRealHostSubprocess or claude --print launcher allowlist.

adversarial.desc: Autopilot cannot widen dispatch policy allowedPaths or commandAllowlist at runtime.

items.title: Implement authority-verified mode gate
items.context: Allow stronger integration only when server authority receipt, tests, scope, and review gates pass; otherwise stop with a classified missing-authority result.
items.userSees: Authority-verified mode either integrates with proof or tells users which authority evidence is missing.

happy.desc: Authority-verified mode accepts a fake server authority receipt plus passing validation and marks story integration allowed.

edge.desc: Authority-verified mode without server receipt stops before auto DONE or main merge.

adversarial.desc: A local diagnostic receipt cannot satisfy server authority receipt requirements.

items.title: Implement full-autopilot loop with stop conditions
items.context: Add bounded loop state machine for plan, dispatch, watch, review, validate, optional fix retry, integrate, and repeat with maxIterations/maxRuntime/maxBudget and conflict/scope stop conditions.
items.userSees: Full-autopilot can loop through bounded repair attempts and stops truthfully when a gate blocks completion.

happy.desc: Full-autopilot fake run completes within maxIterations after validation passes.

edge.desc: Validation failure triggers one bounded retry when allowAutoFix is true and budget/iteration limits allow it.

adversarial.desc: Loop stops on maxIterations, scope violation, conflict, timeout, or budget exhaustion without claiming accepted completion.

items.title: Add merge and conflict manager boundaries
items.context: Separate story-branch integration, main merge, manual merge plan, conflict stop state, and authority/human requirements.
items.userSees: Autopilot explains whether it integrated a story branch, produced a merge plan, or stopped on conflict.

happy.desc: Merge manager reports manualOnly for conservative and integrationAllowed for authority-verified when gates pass.

edge.desc: Conflict state produces a repair task/nextAction and does not delete evidence.

adversarial.desc: No mode merges main unless allowMainMerge plus required authority gate are satisfied.

items.title: Add autopilot observability commands
items.context: Add autopilot_status, autopilot_watch, autopilot_cancel, autopilot_review, and autopilot_resume around persisted run records.
items.userSees: Users can watch, cancel, resume, and review autopilot runs using stable CLI commands.

happy.desc: Status/watch/review show run id, mode, policy, current step, dispatch ids, validation result, and authority fields.

edge.desc: Cancel preserves run evidence and prevents further automation steps.

adversarial.desc: Resume refuses if policy, material evidence, or authority posture is stale/unsafe.

items.title: Add deterministic autopilot smoke test suite
items.context: Add fake-host and fake-authority smoke coverage for conservative, authority-verified, full-autopilot, stop conditions, observability, and no-authority-overclaim invariants.
items.userSees: Maintainers get a stable regression gate proving the three autopilot modes and safety boundaries still work; user-facing usage and delivery closure are handled separately in CHK-011.

happy.desc: Autopilot smoke covers conservative success, authority-verified fake-authority success, and full-autopilot bounded success.

edge.desc: Autopilot smoke covers missing server receipt, validation failure retry, cancel, and resume refusal.

adversarial.desc: Autopilot smoke proves local receipts cannot forge productionDone or receiptVerified.

items.title: Complete docs, review, delivery, and DONE gate
items.context: Keep final user-facing docs, transcript diff, summary, delivery-check, review evidence, and DONE gate separate from the deterministic smoke test implementation.
items.userSees: The final delivery states what modes exist, how to run them, what evidence passed, and which authority boundaries remain.

happy.desc: README and host-overflow docs include user-facing usage and mode boundaries for all three autopilot modes.

edge.desc: Transcript diff and summary compare expected unattended host-to-host development with actual CLI smoke outputs.

adversarial.desc: Delivery reviewer confirms no docs or commands overclaim automatic main merge, productionDone, or verified server authority without proof.
